chunks: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to me from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'When Allah wills good for a servant, He sends to him an angel from the treasurers of Paradise, who strokes his chest and makes him generous with his wealth through Zakat.'
And the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said in his will: 'Be careful, be careful, regarding Zakat, for it extinguishes the anger of your Lord.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of paying Zakat according to Imam Ali and the Prophet?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal* highlights the spiritual mechanism of divine favor, where an angel from the treasurers of Paradise (*Khazānat al-Jannah*) physically and spiritually prepares the believer for charity. Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) concluding advice in his will underscores Zakat not merely as a financial obligation but as a means of appeasing divine wrath, a concept deeply rooted in Shia exegetical tradition regarding the purifying nature of wealth.
